decisions.reason: Demand from airports and airlines was still hard to read after the travel shock, but a mobile app is relatively cheap to keep available and remains a plausible complement to the firm's integrated airport services.

This branded passenger-processing technology is the strongest strategic fit with the firm's airport-security customer base, and the limited evidence so far is too inconclusive to justify closing the option.

A self-service airline check-in solution is more costly to sustain and support, lies somewhat farther from the firm's core security strengths, and overlaps with its other passenger-processing options, making exit the more likely choice.
